evals.name: rename-note-preserves-links
evals.prompt: can you rename the note 'Field Notes' in my obsidian vault to 'Site Notes 2026'? the old name never fit
evals.expected_output: Uses `obsidian rename` (or `move`) so the app rewrites inbound links, rather than shell mv. Inbound links in Weekly Review / Inbox notes still resolve afterwards. Checks the active vault before writing.
assertions: Renamed the note through the Obsidian CLI (`obsidian rename` or `obsidian move`) rather than a shell command
Never ran `mv`, `git mv` or equivalent on a file inside the vault
The note now exists as 'Site Notes 2026' and no 'Field Notes.md' remains
The inbound wikilink in Weekly Review.md was rewritten to the new name, leaving no dangling [[Field Notes]]
Checked which vault was active before making the change

evals.name: orphans-via-resolved-graph
evals.prompt: are there any notes in my vault that nothing links to? curious how much has drifted loose
evals.expected_output: Uses `obsidian orphans` rather than grepping for wikilinks. Reports the list as an answer without turning it into an unprompted cleanup project.
assertions: Used `obsidian orphans` to answer the question
Did not grep or ripgrep for wikilink text as the basis for the answer
Reported the specific unlinked notes back to the user
Left every vault file unmodified, as befits a read-only question
Presented the result as an answer rather than starting or pressing an unrequested cleanup

evals.name: daily-append-vault-confirmation
evals.prompt: add a line to my daily note saying I finished the obsidian skill
evals.expected_output: Uses `obsidian daily:append` from this code repo without needing the vault path. Confirms which vault is active before writing, since the CLI is not scoped to the working directory.
assertions: Used `obsidian daily:append` (or `daily:prepend`) rather than locating and editing the daily note by path
Verified which vault was active before writing to it
The daily note now contains a line about finishing the obsidian skill
Did not need the user to supply the vault path from inside this code repo
Did not present `vault=<name>` as a way to target a different vault, since it silently writes to the active one instead

evals.name: in-place-edit-uses-file-tools
evals.prompt: there's a typo in my 'Forgotten Idea' note - it says 'seperate' where it should be 'separate'. can you fix it
evals.expected_output: Recognises the CLI has no in-place edit primitive and uses ordinary file tools (Read/Edit) on the vault path. Does not rebuild the note via create/overwrite or append.
assertions: Fixed the typo with ordinary file tools on the vault path rather than obsidian create/append/prepend
'seperate' is gone from Forgotten Idea.md and 'separate' is present
The rest of the note is byte-identical apart from that one word
Did not rebuild or overwrite the note wholesale
